text:
Implementation staged on work/real-studio-workflow; no closure claim before integrated full-tree gates.

Extracted FixationCsv's finite-coordinate, correction resolution/application and admission-frame containment step into package-private FixationPositionStep. The importer preserves its existing key/width/item/ordinal/sample/time validation precedence and native correction-conflict whole-trial quarantine.

Added public pure FixationPositions.read keyed by existing TrialIdentity (no invented item). Every data record remains positioned or unplaced with raw fields and typed DataRecord. place uses Agreement, Subframe.locate/enter and LinearAngularScale for corrected/window-local/angular values; transform failures remain explicit records. Native tallies preserve first-source order across positioned and unplaced keys, including zero-positioned invalid-only and conflicting-correction-only trials. Native PointMeasure supplies screen binning; off-frame/unplaced records remain in the output.

RealAdmission now resolves document trial correction targets against exact inventory identities/items and delegates admission to FixationCsv.admitInventory. Missing targets are refused explicitly. RealPlacement is a protocol adapter over the native API and native tallies/binning; root integrated RealStudyBackend.placement with it. Source bytes remain unchanged.

Validation: JDK25, Scala3.7.4, -Werror. FixationPositionsSuite 7/7 and existing AdmissionPolicySuite, FixationRowInterpretationSuite, InventoryAdmissionSuite and FixationTrialDecisionSuite: total37/37 JVM and37/37 Scala.js. Independent analytical coordinates, half-open edges, raw-field/cardinality preservation, both off-screen policies, conflicting scopes, invalid-only/zero-positioned trial retention, empty measures and frame-identity refusal are covered. RealPlacementSuite 4 tests compile independently; integrated runtime still pending shared Studio registry/host source gate.

Mutation evidence: compiler-built mutant only under /private/tmp ignored all coordinate corrections in FixationPositionStep. The import-vs-preview assertion remained equal because both consume that seam; the independent analytical coordinate assertion failed (1 of7 tests, JUnit exit1), killing the mutant. Normal JUnit run7/7 passed. Production source was never mutated, and its bytes were checked unchanged after the run.

Files: io/.../FixationPositionStep.scala, FixationPositions.scala, FixationCsv.scala, FixationPositionsSuite.scala; studio/core/.../real/RealAdmission.scala, RealPlacement.scala, RealPlacementSuite.scala; docs/FIXATION_STUDIES.md. Remaining integrated evidence: real adapter runtime, full library/Studio gates, native sidecar and redraw timing required by S5.5; neither S5.5 nor S3.7 is closed by this implementation alone.
